# German Marshall Fund of the United States

> > The German Marshall Fund of the United States (GMF) strengthens transatlantic cooperation through analysis, convening, and policy dialogue on security, geopolitics, trade, and democratic resilience.

GMF is a nonpartisan policy organization that works to address critical challenges facing the transatlantic community, including NATO security, EU-US relations, Russia policy, Middle East stability, climate change, and disinformation. The organization produces research, podcasts, and commentary featuring experts like Thomas Kleine-Brockhoff and leaders from Washington, Brussels, and allied capitals.

## Key Topics

- Transatlantic Relations
- NATO Security Policy
- European Union Affairs
- Russia and Eastern Europe
- U.S.-Germany Relations
- Middle East Policy
- EU Trade Policy
- Geopolitical Analysis
- Disinformation and Information Security
- Climate and Energy Policy
- Democratic Resilience
- China-Russia Coordination
- Turkey and Regional Security
- Angela Merkel Era Politics
- Brussels Policy Community

## Transatlantic Security and NATO

- [Breakfast Briefing: Russia, the West, and the NATO Warsaw Summit](http://www.gmfus.org/news/breakfast-briefing-russia-west-and-nato-warsaw-summit): Press briefing on Russia-West relations ahead of NATO Warsaw Summit
- [Transatlantic Trends shows strong public support for NATO](http://www.gmfus.org/news/transatlantic-trends-shows-strong-public-support-nato): Survey reveals strong public support for NATO across member states
- [NATO World Views: Tommy Steiner on the NATO-Israel Partnership](http://www.gmfus.org/news/nato-world-views-tommy-steiner-nato-israel-partnership): Tommy Steiner discusses NATO-Israel partnership and Mediterranean security
- [In 8 Minutes or Less: John Bellinger Discusses Transatlantic Counter-Terrorism Approaches](http://www.gmfus.org/news/8-minutes-or-less-john-bellinger-discusses-transatlantic-counter-terrorism-approaches): John Bellinger III on transatlantic counter-terrorism policy approaches

## Europe-U.S. Relations and Leadership

- [Joe Biden's 100 Days of Solitude](http://www.gmfus.org/news/joe-bidens-100-days-solitude): Biden's first 100 days and Germany-US relations under Merkel
- [Out of Order: Germany's Next Merkel?](http://www.gmfus.org/news/out-order-germanys-next-merkel): Podcast on CDU leadership race and Merkel succession candidates
- [The French-American Alliance: A Symbol of Friendship](http://www.gmfus.org/news/french-american-alliance-symbol-friendship): Obama-Hollande meeting highlights French-American alliance strength
- [Ukraine: The U.S. And Europe Need to Speak with One Voice](http://www.gmfus.org/news/ukraine-us-and-europe-need-speak-one-voice): Analysis on US-Europe coordination on Ukraine crisis response

## Disinformation and Information Security

- [Pandemic Playbook: How Beijing is Shaping its Own Story—and Learning from Moscow.](http://www.gmfus.org/news/pandemic-playbook-how-beijing-shaping-its-own-story-and-learning-moscow): China-Russia disinformation tactics during COVID-19 pandemic

## Middle East and Regional Security

- [Out of Order: The Situation in Syria: Dispatches from Ankara and Washington](http://www.gmfus.org/news/out-order-situation-syria-dispatches-ankara-and-washington): Podcast on Syria crisis, US troop withdrawal, and Turkey relations

- [EU trade policy under the Treaty of Lisbon: What will change?](http://www.gmfus.org/news/eu-trade-policy-under-treaty-lisbon-what-will-change-0): Podcast analyzing EU trade policy changes under Treaty of Lisbon

## Global Challenges and Development

- [Will Cities Save Us From Climate Change?](http://www.gmfus.org/news/will-cities-save-us-climate-change): Podcast on cities' role in climate change and energy transition
